source_caption:
𝐂𝐋𝐀𝐘𝐅𝐀𝐂𝐄 takes body horror to a whole new level, turning a desperate attempt to reclaim a lost identity into something far more terrifying.⁣
⁣
The film follows Matt Hagen, a rising Hollywood star whose life takes a horrifying turn after his face is disfigured. Desperate to restore his appearance and career, he turns to experimental science. But what begins as a chance to rebuild his life transforms him into a revenge-driven monster, as he slowly loses control of his body, his identity and ultimately his humanity.⁣
⁣
Written by 𝐌𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐅𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐧, the filmmaker behind Doctor Sleep, Gerald’s Game and The Haunting of Hill House, 𝐂𝐋𝐀𝐘𝐅𝐀𝐂𝐄 promises a disturbing blend of psychological horror, physical transformation and obsession.⁣
⁣
How far would you go to become yourself again?⁣ 👀 
⁣
𝐂𝐋𝐀𝐘𝐅𝐀𝐂𝐄 hits theaters October 23. Tickets are on sale now!⁣
⁣

source_details.title: Clayface
source_details.synopsis: Clayface is a 2026 American body horror-psychological thriller film based on the eponymous character from DC Comics. Directed by James Watkins from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, it is the third film in the DC Universe (DCU). Tom Rhys Harries stars as Matt Hagen / Clayface, alongside Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella, and Eddie Marsan. In the film, Hagen is an actor whose face is disfigured, and he turns to a scientist (Ackie) who transforms his body into clay, but begins to lose his sanity as he is unable to recognise himself.
